name: Grail
source:
The Sixth of the Ten Great Nobles, he is nominated by Ardbelt for the position and enjoys his patronage. In accordance with Ardbelt's wishes, he seeks a way to bring the dead back to life. His primary motivation is to bring back his lost love Beatrice, with whom he made a promise that he would save as many lives as possible when he was famous as a skilled healer before her death drove him mad.

[Spoiler] His ability to create a toxic fog which is lethal to the living and raises the dead back to life as mindless zombies stems from his artefact 生霧. Although his partner Beatrice has been dead for centuries, he has never lost hope of reviving her and deeply resents Primtine for interfering with his research. He has no ambitions for the throne, but is in full agreement with Ardbelt in the creation of a world populated by undying beings. [/Spoiler]
